notes: The microphone is gone from dialogue lines. It was there to judge your pronunciation, that never worked reliably for Croatian or European Portuguese, and recording yourself instead was not worth a button of its own. The speaker button that reads the line aloud stays, which was always the dependable half. The app no longer asks for microphone permission at all. Behind the scenes, the Croatian content checker was silently skipping 28 of the 29 files it was pointed at, including the entire word deck, the grammar reference, the quizzes and the mock exams: it has never once checked them for Serbian forms creeping in. Fixed, and they come back clean.
